title: 連續排放監測系統~Continuous emissions monitoring systems
focus: 把取樣、校正、氣體基準與品質旗標串成可信的連續排放資料~Link sampling, calibration, gas bases and quality flags into credible continuous emission data
summary: 本課以「把取樣、校正、氣體基準與品質旗標串成可信的連續排放資料」為主軸，依序處理量測目的與取樣代表性、水分與乾濕基換算、參考氧濃度校正、與獨立參考法比較、有效資料與缺測旗標。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Link sampling, calibration, gas bases and quality flags into credible continuous emission data, progressing through Measurement objective and sample representativeness, Moisture and wet/dry conversion, Reference-oxygen correction, Comparison with an independent reference, Valid data and missing-value flags. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 量測目的與取樣代表性~Measurement objective and sample representativeness
units.mechanism: 先定污染物、時間窗和煙道截面；單一分析儀讀數需有代表性取樣與適用性能規格支撐。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Define pollutant, time interval and stack cross-section; an analyzer reading needs representative sampling and applicable performance specifications. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「量測目的與取樣代表性」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Measurement objective and sample representativeness, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「量測目的與取樣代表性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Measurement objective and sample representativeness flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 取樣管與全系統延遲~Sampling line and whole-system lag
units.mechanism: 把探頭、加熱管、調理器和分析儀畫成流程，分清資料時間與樣本離開煙道的時間。 輸送延遲會把監測訊號與製程事件錯開，分析前須對齊時間。~Map probe, heated line, conditioner and analyzer and distinguish recorded time from the time the sample left the stack. Transport delay shifts monitoring signals relative to process events; align time before interpretation.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：取樣管容積 V=2 L；流量 q=0.5 L/min。公式 t=V/q，計算得 4 min。適用邊界：理想置換延遲，未含混合、吸附與分析儀響應時間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Sampling-line volume V=2 L; flow q=0.5 L/min. Formula t=V/q gives 4 min. Applicability: Ideal displacement delay without mixing, adsorption or analyzer response time.
units.verify: 針對「取樣管與全系統延遲」，以安全參考訊號或離線脈衝重播測全系統響應，不只使用分析儀規格。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Sampling line and whole-system lag, Use a safe reference signal or offline pulse replay to measure whole-system response, not analyzer specifications alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管線冷凝或吸附會造成較長且不對稱的拖尾。 在「取樣管與全系統延遲」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Condensation or adsorption in tubing causes longer asymmetric tails. Mark where this error can enter the Sampling line and whole-system lag flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 分析儀更新每秒一次就代表取樣點到畫面只延遲一秒。~One-second analyzer updates imply only one-second source-to-display delay.
units.practice: 只將 q 改成 0.8 L/min，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 4 變成 2.5 min。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only q to 0.8 L/min, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 4 to 2.5 min. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 水分與乾濕基換算~Moisture and wet/dry conversion
units.mechanism: 保留樣本含濕與調理方式，檢查可溶性物種是否在冷凝過程流失。 移除水蒸氣後同量污染物對應較小乾氣體積，因此乾基濃度高於濕基。~Retain moisture and conditioning method and check whether soluble species are lost during condensation. Removing water vapour leaves the same pollutant in a smaller dry-gas volume, so dry concentration exceeds wet concentration.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕基 Cw=40 mg/m³；水蒸氣體積分率 H=0.10。公式 Cd=Cw/(1-H)，計算得 44.4444 mg per dry m³。適用邊界：理想氣體且前後溫壓基準一致，未考慮污染物溶入冷凝水。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet concentration Cw=40 mg/m³; water-vapour volume fraction H=0.10. Formula Cd=Cw/(1-H) gives 44.4444 mg per dry m³. Applicability: Ideal gas with matching temperature and pressure bases, excluding pollutant dissolution in condensate.
units.verify: 針對「水分與乾濕基換算」，保留含濕量與氣體基準，檢查取樣調理是否同時移除可溶性污染物。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture and wet/dry conversion, Retain moisture and gas bases and check whether sample conditioning also removes soluble pollutants. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把已乾燥的訊號再作乾基校正會重複放大濃度。 在「水分與乾濕基換算」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Applying dry correction again to an already dry measurement double-increases concentration. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and wet/dry conversion flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 乾基與濕基只差標籤，數值必定相同。~Dry and wet bases differ only in label and always have equal values.
units.practice: 只將 H 改成 0.20，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 44.4444 變成 50 mg per dry m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only H to 0.20, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 44.4444 to 50 mg per dry m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 零點、跨度與線性~Zero, span and linearity
units.mechanism: 用多點參考資料分離偏移與增益誤差，將定期查核與實際調整分開記錄。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。~Separate offset and gain errors using multipoint references and distinguish periodic checks from adjustments. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
units.verify: 針對「零點、跨度與線性」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Zero, span and linearity, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「零點、跨度與線性」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Zero, span and linearity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 零點校正正確就保證所有量程的讀值都正確。~A correct zero guarantees correct readings across the whole range.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 參考氧濃度校正~Reference-oxygen correction
units.mechanism: 對需要的報告項才套用適用參考氧值，保留原始乾基濃度並防止重複校正。 氧校正比較固定參考氧濃度下的稀釋程度，不能與乾濕基校正混為一項。~Apply an applicable reference oxygen only to report items requiring it, retain raw dry concentration and prevent duplicate correction. Oxygen correction normalizes dilution to a reference oxygen concentration and is separate from moisture correction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾基濃度 C=50 mg/Nm³；量測 O₂=10%；假想參考 O₂ref=11%。公式 Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2)，計算得 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。適用邊界：以 21% 空氣氧近似且氧測值遠低於 21%；參考值僅為算例，不聲稱適用法規。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry concentration C=50 mg/Nm³; measured O₂=10%; hypothetical reference O₂ref=11%. Formula Cref=C*(21-O2ref)/(21-O2) gives 45.4545 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Applicability: Approximate air oxygen at 21%, with measured oxygen well below it; the reference is illustrative, not a legal claim.
units.verify: 針對「參考氧濃度校正」，保存原始濃度、含濕與 O₂，再重算每項校正，防止對已校正數據重複校正。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Reference-oxygen correction, Retain raw concentration, moisture and O₂ and recompute corrections to avoid double normalization. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 接近空氣氧含量時分母很小，微小氧誤差會放大。 在「參考氧濃度校正」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Near ambient oxygen the denominator is small and minor oxygen errors amplify strongly. Mark where this error can enter the Reference-oxygen correction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氧校正能消除任何煙道漏氣與取樣代表性的問題。~Oxygen correction eliminates every leakage and sampling-representativeness problem.
units.practice: 只將量測 O₂ 改成 12%，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45.4545 變成 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only measured O₂ to 12%, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 45.4545 to 55.5556 mg/Nm³ at assumed reference. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 濃度轉質量排放~Concentration to mass emission
units.mechanism: 把流量與濃度的乾濕、溫壓及時間基準對齊，再算質量率；單獨濃度無法描述總負荷。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Align moisture, temperature, pressure and time bases of flow and concentration before calculating mass rate. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「濃度轉質量排放」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Concentration to mass emission, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「濃度轉質量排放」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Concentration to mass emission flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 與獨立參考法比較~Comparison with an independent reference
units.mechanism: 使用未參與校正的參考資料查核殘差，檢查全系統誤差而非只驗分析儀。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。~Check residuals with independent reference data excluded from calibration and assess the full system rather than the analyzer alone. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
units.verify: 針對「與獨立參考法比較」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Comparison with an independent reference, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「與獨立參考法比較」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Comparison with an independent reference flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 零點校正正確就保證所有量程的讀值都正確。~A correct zero guarantees correct readings across the whole range.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 負荷不確定度預算~Load uncertainty budget
units.mechanism: 濃度與流量共用溫壓訊號時可能相關，先檢查共變異才使用獨立誤差近似。 獨立乘積量的相對方差近似相加；有共同校正來源時需加入共變異。~Concentration and flow may share temperature or pressure signals; inspect covariance before using an independent-error approximation. Relative variances of independent product quantities approximately add; common calibration sources require covariance.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：獨立相對標準不確定度：流量 uQ=0.04、濃度 uC=0.06。公式 u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²)，計算得 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty。適用邊界：小誤差一階傳播與獨立性假設；標準不確定度不等於 95% 區間。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Independent relative standard uncertainties: flow uQ=0.04, concentration uC=0.06. Formula u=sqrt(uQ²+uC²) gives 0.072111 relative standard uncertainty. Applicability: Small-error first-order propagation and independence; standard uncertainty is not a 95% interval.
units.verify: 針對「負荷不確定度預算」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Load uncertainty budget, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「負荷不確定度預算」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Load uncertainty budget flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 重複量測次數越多，所有系統性誤差都會自動消失。~More repeats automatically eliminate every systematic error.
units.practice: 只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 有效資料與缺測旗標~Valid data and missing-value flags
units.mechanism: 將校正、維護、異常及通訊斷線分開標記，缺值絕不能直接當作零排放。 完整率追蹤有效資料覆蓋；缺值可能集中在尖峰事件，不能只看比例。~Flag calibration, maintenance, faults and communication loss separately and never treat missing values as zero emissions. Completeness tracks valid coverage; gaps may cluster during peaks, so percentage alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：應有時段 N=1440；有效時段 n=1320。公式 coverage=n/N*100，計算得 91.6667 %。適用邊界：明確時間格與有效性規則；本題不宣稱任何法規有效率門檻。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Expected intervals N=1440; valid intervals n=1320. Formula coverage=n/N*100 gives 91.6667 %. Applicability: Explicit interval grid and validity rules; no regulatory completeness threshold is claimed.
units.verify: 針對「有效資料與缺測旗標」，畫出缺值時間軸並保留校正、維護與通訊錯誤旗標，禁止把缺值填成零。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Valid data and missing-value flags, Plot missing intervals with calibration, maintenance and communication flags; never replace missing values with zero. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 高污染時停機造成選擇性缺值，可偏低估平均污染。 在「有效資料與缺測旗標」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Outages during high pollution cause selective missingness and can bias the average downward. Mark where this error can enter the Valid data and missing-value flags flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 缺測資料填成零不會影響污染平均值。~Replacing missing data with zero does not affect mean pollution.
units.practice: 只將 n 改成 1200，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 91.6667 變成 83.3333 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only valid intervals n to 1200, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 91.6667 to 83.3333 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 事件回放與報告追溯~Event replay and report traceability
units.mechanism: 讓玩家由報告值回查原始訊號、校正版本和品質旗標，用可用率交代系統維護而非取代合格資料率。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Trace reports back to raw signals, calibration versions and quality flags; use availability for maintenance performance, not valid-data compliance. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「事件回放與報告追溯」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Event replay and report traceability, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「事件回放與報告追溯」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Event replay and report traceability flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
